cases.prompt: I added a package to packages/api for the new preferences endpoint and staged it. Before I merge, check whether that brings in known vulnerabilities.
Which version of Express does packages/api use, and does the error middleware in app.js receive errors thrown by async route handlers? Just explain, no changes.
Check the dependencies of this repo for security problems after my staged change in packages/api, and tell me what must be fixed before the release, with the OWASP category of each finding.
cases.review: The report names each tool of the chain with its exact command and why it did not run (no shell permission, and npm audit needs package-lock.json, which the repo does not have); flags the missing lockfile (A03:2025); reports lodash 4.17.15 in packages/api/package.json as an Unconfirmed known vulnerable version with its fixed version and runtime exposure, mapped to A03:2025 with CWE-1395; flags the deep merge of req.body in packages/api/src/routes/preferences.js (prototype pollution, CWE-1321) and the route with no authorization; ends with 'Scan: partial (...)' and the counts. It installs nothing, creates no lockfile and changes no file.
